entries.descriptionOriginal: ✿ Pink Mirage ✿ the softest Mirage ever (｡♥‿♥｡) Hiii~! ♡ Welcome to Pink Mirage: classic de_mirage, all dressed up in pastel pink, mint, lavender and cream! ✧･ﾟ: *✧･ﾟ:* Same Mirage you know and love... same angles, same smokes, same timings. Just way, WAY cuter. ( ˘ ³˘)♥ ♡ What's inside ♡ ✿ The full Mirage layout: A site, B site, mid, palace, apps, connector, jungle... all of it! ✿ Dreamy pastel colours everywhere: pink walls, mint trims, lavender shade and creamy floors ✿ Cute posters hidden on the walls (look around~) ✿ Giant mascot friends hiding around the map... can you find all 6? ʕ•ᴥ•ʔ ✿ Soft baked lighting, so it stays pretty AND easy to see ☆ How to play ☆ Press the green Subscribe button ♡ Open CS2 → Play → Workshop Maps Pick Pink Mirage and have fun! (ﾉ◕ヮ◕)ﾉ*:･ﾟ✧ Or type in the console: map de_pink_mirage Perfect for casual, deathmatch, a cozy 5v5 with friends, or practising your Mirage smokes in style~ ♪ ♡ Little notes ♡ Bloom and some effects are a little lighter than in real Mirage, so it stays soft on the eyes~ It's its own map, so Valve's real Mirage is never changed. Original Mirage by Valve ♡ pink makeover made with love If Pink Mirage made you smile, please give it a thumbs up ★ and add it to your favourites~ it really helps! Arigatou~ (◕‿◕✿)
